_annotation.purpose: Ground truth for SRS acceptance criterion 1 — 'given a sample GR preamble, the system correctly extracts at least 80% of cited references'.
_annotation.annotator: single annotator (project author), by reading each document's Read / वाचा block directly from the source PDF's first page
_annotation.scope: the Read/वाचा (preamble reference) block only — the unit named by AC-1
_annotation.unit: one distinct cited DOCUMENT. Where the same file number is cited several times with different dates, it counts once (the extractor's job is to surface the cited document).
_annotation.excluded: letters (पत्र) from officials are recorded as n_letters but excluded from the metric — FR-1 scopes extraction to GRs, circulars and court orders.
_annotation.signature: digit tokens that must ALL appear inside one extracted reference (or code). Digits survive the legacy-font garble verbatim — the same property the corpus repair step's digit audit relies on — so they identify a citation even when every surrounding word is corrupted. `null` = the citation carries no file number at all (cited as 'this department's GR of <date>'), so no signature exists to match.
_annotation.CIRCULARITY WARNING: corpus.jsonl's cited_codes / cited_refs must NOT be used as ground truth here — they are the output of the same extract_citations() under test.
_annotation.sampling: the 12 archived GRs are the first quality_verdict=='clean' corpus GRs (sorted by code) whose PDF is present and contains a Read block — not cherry-picked for extraction success.
